name: Soya Chunk Tikka
steps: Boil soya in the measured water for 5 minutes until soft. Drain, rinse cool and squeeze thoroughly; halve large chunks.
Crush ginger and garlic. Mix with curd, spices, salt, lemon juice and 15 ml oil to make a thick marinade.
Cut pepper and onion into 3 cm pieces. Coat them and soya with marinade; refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Thread alternating soya, onion and pepper onto metal skewers without packing tightly. Heat a grill pan over medium-high heat and brush with the remaining 15 ml oil.
Grill in batches for 12 minutes, turning regularly until browned on several sides and steaming hot inside. Serve immediately, sliding the tikka off the skewers.
tips: Squeeze the soya well and use thick curd so the marinade clings.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
